name: Dithereal
summary: Ten dithered WebGL components for React: animated controls, agent identities, loaders and image effects.
description: A collection of ten React components on one compact dither system, rendered with WebGL: animated controls (button, checkbox, switch, slider), feedback and display pieces (loader, badge, card, agent identities), a content divider, and Ditherize, an image treatment that turns a picture into an ordered-dither field. Components install through a shadcn-style registry with npx dithereal add dithereal; ordered-pixel fields stay legible in light and dark, with palette controls, center-out reveals, directional trails and reduced-motion fallbacks.
contains: components: Dither Agents, checkbox, loader, slider, button, switch, badge, card, content divider
Ditherize image treatment with dot size, spacing, angle and palette controls
installs with npx dithereal add dithereal from a shadcn registry (10 items)
ordered-pixel fields stay legible in light and dark
center-out reveals, directional trails, dust-like sparks and reduced-motion fallbacks
